knobs.name: chunk.concurrency
knobs.doc: concurrent range-split chunk fetches; overrides --range-concurrency once set

knobs.name: chunk.depth_dynamic
knobs.doc: size the per-tunnel chunk depth from each tunnel's bandwidth-delay product instead of chunk.per_tunnel

knobs.name: chunk.depth_max
knobs.doc: ceiling on the dynamic per-tunnel depth

knobs.name: chunk.depth_min
knobs.doc: floor on the dynamic per-tunnel depth (the fixed depth it replaces)

knobs.name: chunk.free_retries
knobs.doc: refetches a tunnel death may buy a chunk without charging its budget

knobs.name: chunk.idle_timeout
knobs.doc: rolling no-progress deadline on a chunk body read

knobs.name: chunk.max_bytes
knobs.doc: range-split chunk ceiling; overrides --range-chunk-kib once set

knobs.name: chunk.min_bytes
knobs.doc: smallest chunk the planner will produce

knobs.name: chunk.outstanding_factor
knobs.doc: outstanding chunk buffers as a multiple of the fetch concurrency

knobs.name: chunk.per_tunnel
knobs.doc: chunks the planner aims to give each active tunnel

knobs.name: chunk.probe_bytes
knobs.doc: bytes chunk0 asks for — the size probe, and the no-split threshold

knobs.name: chunk.retry_budget
knobs.doc: how long a failed chunk keeps being refetched before it gives up

knobs.name: chunk.tunnel_concurrency
knobs.doc: chunks one tunnel may carry at once on a split download the spread policy steers

knobs.name: mux.cap
knobs.doc: ceiling on the mux legs this app's dials ask for (0 = the visor-wide adaptive ceiling)

knobs.name: mux.width
knobs.doc: mux legs this app's dials ask for (0 = the visor-wide adaptive width)

knobs.name: pool.exclude_pks
knobs.doc: public keys the pool's dials must not use as a first hop or an intermediate (comma-separated; empty = no exclusion)

knobs.name: pool.fill_interval
knobs.doc: how often the keepalive loop adds one more standby tunnel

knobs.name: pool.freeze
knobs.doc: hold the active set still: the promoter makes no discretionary swap and the pool neither fills nor shrinks. A dead tunnel is still replaced, and a reconcile the operator asks for still runs

knobs.name: pool.require_tp_types
knobs.doc: transport types a pool dial's FIRST HOP must have, e.g. stcpr,sudph (comma-separated; empty = any type)

knobs.name: pool.retry_backoff_base
knobs.doc: first wait after a round of failed standby-pool dials

knobs.name: pool.retry_backoff_max
knobs.doc: ceiling on the standby-pool dial backoff

knobs.name: pool.retry_rounds
knobs.doc: rounds of failed dials before the pool fill rests until a death

knobs.name: pool.size
knobs.doc: CEILING on tunnels held to the exit including the active ones; overrides --standby-pool once set (0 = active tunnels only)

knobs.name: pool.standby_rtt_stale
knobs.doc: how long a standby tunnel may be silent and still be promoted

knobs.name: range.port
knobs.doc: destination port the splitter treats as plaintext HTTP; overrides --range-port once set

knobs.name: spread.endgame
knobs.doc: duplicate the last chunks on the fastest idle route and take the first to finish

knobs.name: spread.max_share
knobs.doc: largest fraction of one object's bytes any single route may carry (1 = uncapped)

knobs.name: spread.min_routes
knobs.doc: routes an object must be spread over, promoting standbys to reach it (0 = no floor)

knobs.name: spread.weight
knobs.doc: how a route's share is chosen: rate = proportional to measured capacity, even = equal

knobs.name: tunnel.audition_every
knobs.doc: minimum gap between two auditions of the same tunnel

knobs.name: tunnel.audition_window
knobs.doc: how long an audition offer stands before it expires

knobs.name: tunnel.count
knobs.doc: size of the ACTIVE tunnel set; overrides --tunnels once set, reconciled by promote/park on the next tick

knobs.name: tunnel.depth_margin
knobs.doc: added to a tunnel's RTT in the bandwidth-delay queue depth

knobs.name: tunnel.exit_open_penalty
knobs.doc: how long a tunnel sits out the picks after an exit open timed out

knobs.name: tunnel.goodput_alpha
knobs.doc: weight of each carrying window in a tunnel's delivered-goodput EWMA

knobs.name: tunnel.goodput_fresh
knobs.doc: how long a tunnel's measured goodput stays usable for a promotion decision; past it the tunnel is unmeasured again and the audition re-measures it

knobs.name: tunnel.goodput_min_windows
knobs.doc: carrying windows a tunnel needs before its goodput counts as measured

knobs.name: tunnel.liveness_interval
knobs.doc: how often the keepalive loop probes each tunnel for liveness

knobs.name: tunnel.meter_cap_decay
knobs.doc: per-sample decay applied to a busy tunnel's capacity estimate

knobs.name: tunnel.meter_fresh
knobs.doc: how long a busy window's capacity estimate stays authoritative

knobs.name: tunnel.meter_sample_min
knobs.doc: shortest interval a tunnel capacity sample is taken over

knobs.name: tunnel.park_min_hold
knobs.doc: how long a parked tunnel stays out of the candidate set

knobs.name: tunnel.probe_fail_window
knobs.doc: how long a liveness ping may stay unanswered before it counts as a FAILED probe; a tunnel is retired only when it is BOTH silent for the hard-dead window and has a failed probe, so a local dataplane stall no longer retires healthy standbys

knobs.name: tunnel.probe_interval
knobs.doc: how often each tunnel's RTT is re-measured (also the settings-pull tick)

knobs.name: tunnel.promote_goodput_margin
knobs.doc: how much more a standby must have been measured DELIVERING than the weakest active before it may swap in

knobs.name: tunnel.promote_hold
knobs.doc: how long an advantage must hold before the swap fires

knobs.name: tunnel.promote_idle_bps
knobs.doc: measured goodput at or above which an active tunnel counts as PRODUCTIVE, so a lower round trip alone can never park it

knobs.name: tunnel.promote_interval
knobs.doc: how often the promoter considers a standby/active swap

knobs.name: tunnel.promote_margin
knobs.doc: how much better a standby must measure before it may swap in

knobs.name: tunnel.promote_quiet_bytes
knobs.doc: bytes an active tunnel may move between two promoter ticks and still count as idle; above it the tunnel is mid-transfer and is never parked

knobs.name: tunnel.rtt_alpha
knobs.doc: weight of each new ping in a tunnel's RTT EWMA

knobs.name: tunnel.snub_after
knobs.doc: no byte and no ack for this long, with work outstanding, snubs a tunnel (floored at 2x its smoothed RTT; kept above the longest measured reorder-wedge clear so a head-of-line-blocked tunnel is not re-issued)

knobs.name: tunnel.snub_hold
knobs.doc: how long a snubbed tunnel sits out before it is re-tried with ONE chunk

knobs.name: upload.ack_timeout
knobs.doc: how long a chunk waits for its ack once its body is out

knobs.name: upload.burst_plan
knobs.doc: place a striped upload whose chunks are ALL admitted at once by measured upload capacity and RTT, keeping the object's last chunk off the slow route

knobs.name: upload.busy_backoff
knobs.doc: wait between retries when the sink answers 503, its sessions all taken

knobs.name: upload.busy_tries
knobs.doc: 503s one chunk waits out before the upload fails

knobs.name: upload.chunk_bytes
knobs.doc: CEILING on one striped-upload chunk; the size is planned from the object under it

knobs.name: upload.concurrency
knobs.doc: chunks one tunnel may carry at once on a striped upload

knobs.name: upload.cut_tries
knobs.doc: times one chunk is sent again after the sink refused it as short — the body was cut in flight, not by the sink

knobs.name: upload.depth_dynamic
knobs.doc: size the per-tunnel upload depth from the bandwidth-delay product instead of upload.concurrency; shares chunk.depth_min/max and tunnel.depth_margin

knobs.name: upload.durable_wait
knobs.doc: how long an acked chunk waits for the sink's prefix to reach it before it is re-sent

knobs.name: upload.early_tries
knobs.doc: 425s one chunk may wait out before the upload gives up

knobs.name: upload.early_wait_max
knobs.doc: ceiling on the Retry-After a 425 may impose

knobs.name: upload.idle_timeout
knobs.doc: rolling no-progress deadline on a chunk body write

knobs.name: upload.mem_bytes
knobs.doc: ceiling on the upload chunk buffers alive at once, whatever the body size

knobs.name: upload.probe_ttl
knobs.doc: how long an origin's X-Chunked-Upload answer is trusted

knobs.name: upload.replay_max_bytes
knobs.doc: largest generic POST body remembered so it can be replayed on another tunnel

knobs.name: upload.replay_tries
knobs.doc: times a generic POST may be replayed after its tunnel died uncommitted

knobs.name: upload.resend_passes
knobs.doc: passes one chunk may be sent again because the sink's prefix never reached it

knobs.name: upload.stripe_min_bytes
knobs.doc: smallest POST body addressed in chunks rather than sent as one stream
